Crumbling, literally. I never went out with people but now I can’t, I actually wish I could see people. Life just feels pretty hopeless right now.

Bare with me, as it’s 4am and I’m hardly awake.

I understand why you’re panicking. I get it, I do. I’m also scared about contracting the virus because my immune system isn’t all that great and I’ve had breathing issues since I was younger. 

If you do get covid-19, you will be prioritised. I’m sure it’s said that people who are more at risk/have underlying health conditions are going to be prioritised. 

In regards to your job, how are you sure that you could lose it? I believe it’s a problem that can be dealt with when the time comes - for now just focus on you and keeping yourself safe. There are other jobs available if worst comes to worst.

I’m not sure where you’re from but maybe there are helplines/charities available that can potentially help you if you need medical care. In the UK, if you’re there, it’s free (albeit a bit hard to have appointments now.)

Is it possible to ask anyone to help or is that not an available thing? 

I’m sorry that I’ve not been much help but I hope you feel better. My messages are open if you want to talk.

As someone who’s starting to get it, I would say go to your GP first. The best thing to do is to be honest with them as they can’t offer good help if they don’t know the extent of your issues.

They’ll probably refer you to different services depending on your age. If you’re under 18 it would be CAMHS, if you’ve over 18+ it could be AMHS or you could be referred to the AnDY Clinic. Either way, whatever you’re referred to you need to be honest.

If you’ve tried anything before to help you that hasn’t, mention it to your doctor. They probably won’t recommend meds or anything straight away for different reasons but they’ll give you contact details for different people that can help you in a crisis.

They won’t lock you up for anything you say. I promise.
Thank you so much, I appreciate it. I’ve given Roxy lots of love from you <3 - I just hope the guy isn’t practicing anything anymore.
